name: Guided Blades reduces Warden's Blade's cooldown by 5 sec (#1063)
contract: Guided Blades 680738 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -5001 with DieSides 1 -> -5000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x4000000. Warden's Blade ranks 1-6 (805508, 806812-806816) carry SpellFamilyFlags word1 0x4000000 and RecoveryTime 20000, so the mask selects every rank; the tooltip is 'Reduces the cooldown of Warden's Blade by 5 sec.'. The module never edits the cooldown (AscensionStarcallerAbilities.cpp only reads 805508 after the hit). Native consumer: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns (Player.cpp:11452) calls ApplySpellMod(spellId, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, rec, spell) on the spell's RecoveryTime, which computes basevalue * totalmul + totalflat. The spell_modifier metric calls the same Player::ApplySpellMod for op 11 on the base value 20000 for spell 806816 (rank 6), so no cast, target or range is needed and no hit roll can interfere. Expected: 20000 on the control, 15000 (-5000) with the talent. A real cast is not used because Warden's Blade needs a hostile target inside 10 yards and its cooldown read would race the harness's miss rolls.
